परि-√ नन्द् (only ind.p. -नन्द्य), to rejoice greatly, give great pleasure to (acc.), MBh. xv, 522.

censoriousness, Subh.
परि-निन्दन n. g. क्षुभ्नादि.

परि-निर्-मित mfn. (√ 3. मा) formed, created (said of Viṣṇu), Viṣṇ.
marked off, limited, R.
settled, determined, MBh.

परि-निर्-√ 2. वा P. -वाति, to be completely extinguished or emancipated (from individual existence), attain absolute rest, Lalit. : Caus. -वापयति, to emancipate completely by causing extinction of all re-births, Vajracch.
परिनिर्˚वाण mfn. completely extinguished or finished (अ-परिनिर्व्˚), Śak.
a: परिनिर्वाण — a. Completely extinguished. --णं Final extinction (of the individual).

परिनिर्˚वायिन् mfn. being completely ex˚ or em˚, Divyāv.
परि-निर्वपण n. (√ 2. वप्) distributing, dispensing, giving, W.

परि-निर्वृति f. final liberation, complete emancipation, Rājat.

a: परिनिर्वृत्तिः — f. Final liberation or complete emancipation of the soul from the body and exemption from future transmigration.

m: परि-निर्विण्ण mfn. (√ 3. विद्) extremely disgusted with (loc.), MBh.

परि-नि-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to pass away, MBh.

m: परि-नि-ष्ठा (√ स्था), Caus. -ष्ठापयति to teach thoroughly, Uttarar.
परि-निष्ठा f. extreme limit, highest point, MBh.; Kap.
complete knowledge, familiarity with (loc. or comp.), Śaṃk.; Pur.
a: परिनिष्ठा — 1 Complete knowledge or acquaintance (of anything). --2 Complete accomplishment. --3 Extreme limit.

m: परि-निष्ठान n. (only अ-न्˚). the being completely fixed, L.

परि-निष्ठापनीय mfn. to be exactly fixed or defined, ĀpŚr.
परि-निष्ठित mfn. quite perfect, accomplished, Śaṃk.
being in (loc.), Hariv.; Pur.
completely skilled in or acquainted with (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: परिनिष्ठित — p. p. 1 Completely skilled in. --2 Not well fixed; अपरिनिष्ठितस्योपदेशस्यान्याय्यं प्रकाशनं M. 1.

m: परि-नि-षद् (√ सद्) P. -षीदति (3. pl. pf. Ā. -षेदिरे ind.p. -षद्य) to sit around, RV.
परि-नि-षेव् (√ सेव्) Ā. -षेवते, MBh. xiii, 3087, prob. w.r. for -षेच्यते (√ सिच्).
परि-नि-षिच् (√ सिच्) P. -षिञ्चति to pour down upon, endow richly, MBh. (cf. next).
परि-निष्पादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) developed, manifested, Kāraṇḍ.
परि-निष्-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to change or turn into (nom.), Kāraṇḍ.
परि-निष्पन्न mfn. developed, perfect, real, existing, Śaṃk.; Buddh.
परि-निष्पन्न—त्व n. real being, reality, Śaṃk.
परि-निष्पत्ति f. perfection, Vajracch.
परि-न्यास m. completing the sense of a passage, W.
alluding to the development of the seed (बीज) or origin of a dramatic plot, Daśar.
a: परिन्यासः — 1 Completing the sense of a passage. --2 Alluding to the development of the origin of the dramatic plot.

m: परि-न्य्-अस्त mfn. (√ 2. अस्) stretched out, extended, Kathās.
